1.7.27（268）画布设计流程、储存诊断与日志化决策（候选版）

• 画布设计：简报/规格/DESIGN.md → 导入或生成 → 锚定反馈 → 修订绑定的候选 → 确认后采纳（同一次 CAS 更新真实节点内容）→ 用真实解析器验证导出。
• 工程规格：简报/规格保存在画布工程自身，一次提交应用到所有设计节点，新节点自动继承；重复相同内容不会产生多余修订。
• 使用当前节点：把节点上已有的文本、素材或已绑定的 CAD/Office 文档直接冻结为设计修订，无需外部导出再导入。
• 日志化反馈：采纳/拒绝通知发送到提出提案的原始任务；发送失败或崩溃会在下次启动自动补送，不会丢失。
• 模板：应用前校验实际负载摘要；签名模板须匹配包摘要并包含 DESIGN.md 入口。
• 储存：分类去重计量，区分逻辑长度与已分配字节；清理仅针对任务持有的临时区，删除前确认无运行占用。
• CAD 全屏编辑：图纸预览在解析完成前进入全屏时，编辑入口也能稳定出现。
• 图片证据：工具返回图片先做大小与真实格式校验，去重后完整送达视觉模型。

请重点测试：iPad 横竖屏/分屏、iPhone 窄屏，设计导入→提案→采纳→导出，多节点工程规格，使用当前节点，储存扫描与清理报告。

说明：本构建为候选版本，已通过聚焦与回归测试；真机、真实模型服务和 Apple 验收均未完成。云端 AI 需自行配置服务；设计提案需确认后才会应用。

1.7.27 (268): Canvas design workflow, storage diagnostics, durable decisions (candidate)

• Canvas design: brief/spec/DESIGN.md → import or generate → anchored feedback → revision-bound candidates → confirmed adoption that updates the real node content in one CAS commit → verified export reopened with the real parser.
• Project spec: the brief/spec lives on the Canvas project; one commit applies it to every design node and new nodes inherit it. Repeating identical content creates no extra revision.
• Use current node: freeze the node's existing text, asset bytes or bound CAD/Office document into a design revision without an external export/reimport.
• Durable notices: adopt/reject outcomes are delivered to the task that proposed them; failed or interrupted deliveries are repaired on the next launch.
• Templates: the stored payload is verified against its digest before applying; signed templates must match the package digest and contain the DESIGN.md entrypoint.
• Storage: categorized, deduplicated measurement of logical vs allocated bytes; cleanup is limited to the task-owned scratch area with owner probes before deletion.
• CAD fullscreen editing: the Edit entry now installs reliably when the drawing preview enters fullscreen before parsing finishes.
• Visual evidence: tool images are size- and format-checked against the real bytes, deduplicated, and delivered to vision models in full.

Please test iPad portrait/landscape/split view, iPhone compact layouts, design import→propose→adopt→export, multi-node project spec, Use current node, and the storage scan/cleanup report.

Limits: candidate build that passed focused and regression test suites; physical-device, real-provider and Apple acceptance remain open. Cloud AI requires your configured provider. Proposed design edits apply only after confirmation.
